build_faiss_flat_index: build a FAISS flat index from candidate encodings and serialize to an output path
build_faiss_hnsw_index: build a FAISS HNSW index from candidate encodings with a configurable memory buffer size
build_faiss_ivfflat_index: build a FAISS IVF flat index from candidate encodings with 75 clusters and 100 probes
run_build_faiss_index: run the CLI module to build and save a FAISS index from a PyTorch encoding file
review_main_function: review the main function that loads candidate encodings and builds a FAISS index
